description: This file implements the 'List' feature in the Comments domain, containing a request query, a handler to process the request, and logic to retrieve comments related to an article by its slug, including error handling for not found articles.

classes.name: List.Query
classes.description: A request object containing the article slug to retrieve associated comments.

classes.name: List.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the query to list comments for an article specified by slug, retrieving from the database and handling errors if the article is not found.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Executes the process of fetching article comments based on the provided slug and returns a CommentsEnvelope; throws a RestException if the article does not exist.
